summary: Clean navigation refactor that correctly fixes the double-click back-button bug by unifying both navigation paths through a shared navigateBack helper. All 69 tests pass, live validation confirms single-click behavior.

comments.body: nitpick: `onClick={() => handleBackClick()}` creates a new arrow function on each render. Since `handleBackClick` is already wrapped in `useCallback` and accepts an optional param, `onClick={handleBackClick}` would work here — the React `MouseEvent` would be passed as `extraState`, but `extraState?.pendingOrderSymbol` would be `undefined` so the `if` block is safely skipped. That said, the wrapper is arguably clearer about intent (no args passed), so this is purely stylistic.
